kv.memory.crypto-backend-policy: mimid: Mark dislikes aws-lc/ring but decided (2026-10-17) NOT to enforce a ban; accept whatever deps pull in (e.g. rustls default provider) and fix later. Do not add cargo-deny bans for ring/aws-lc unless asked.
kv.memory.lang-and-spec-target: mimid: MIMI reference implementation over MLS (RFC 9420). Language: Rust (decided 2026-10-17). Spec target: implement the LATEST version of each MIMI draft exactly as written, regardless of draft expiry/maturity; where a draft is ambiguous, pick the sane reading and document it.
